entities.summary: Tuukka Mikael Rask is a Finnish former professional ice hockey goaltender. Rask was drafted 21st overall in the 2005 NHL entry draft by the Toronto Maple Leafs before being traded to the Boston Bruins in 2006, where he played his entire 15 season NHL career. Rask was consistently successful during his tenure with the Bruins. After winning the Stanley Cup as the backup with the Bruins in 2011, he led the Bruins to the Stanley Cup Final on two occasions in 2013 and 2019. He also won the Vezina Trophy as the league's top goaltender during the 2013–14 season, and was a finalist for the 2019–20 award.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Tuukka Rask's two Stanley Cup Final appearances and one championship win had a significant impact on the Boston Bruins' franchise history, while his Vezina Trophy win in 2014 cemented his status as one of the league's top goaltenders.
